topic: 近一年 loco-manipulation 研究进展

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): Loco-manipulation is not a single metadata vocabulary. The run must cover legged loco-manipulation, humanoid/whole-body manipulation, wheeled mobile manipulation, contact-rich control, data collection, evaluation, and deployment.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-loco-manipulation-exact
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"loco-manipulation" OR all:"locomanipulation" OR all:"loco manipulation"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture exact spellings used by the field.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-legged-arm-whole-body
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:quadruped OR all:legged) AND (all:manipulation OR all:manipulator) AND all:"whole-body"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture arm-equipped quadrupeds and other legged whole-body controllers that omit the exact term loco-manipulation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-humanoid-whole-body-manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Humanoid work often frames integrated locomotion, balance, reaching, and contact as whole-body manipulation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-mobile-manipulation-coupled
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"mobile manipulation" AND (all:"whole-body" OR all:coupled OR all:visuomotor)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover wheeled systems that jointly learn or optimize base and arm actions.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-contact-force-tactile
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"loco-manipulation" OR all:"whole-body manipulation") AND (all:contact OR all:force OR all:tactile OR all:compliance)

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-data-teleop-imitation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"whole-body manipulation" OR all:"mobile manipulation") AND (all:teleoperation OR all:demonstration OR all:imitation) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover scalable whole-body data collection and policy learning.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-sim-real-reinforcement
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"loco-manipulation" OR all:"whole-body manipulation") AND (all:"reinforcement learning" OR all:"sim-to-real")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture the dominant simulation/RL and transfer route.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-evaluation-benchmark
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"mobile manipulation" OR all:"whole-body manipulation" OR all:"loco-manipulation") AND (all:benchmark OR all:evaluation OR all:dataset)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find benchmark, robot suite, and evaluation papers rather than only positive methods.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-limit-failure-safety
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"mobile manipulation" OR all:"whole-body manipulation" OR all:"loco-manipulation") AND (all:failure OR all:limitation OR all:safety OR all:robustness)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Force coverage of failure modes, safety, robustness, and negative surfaces.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-deployment-recovery
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"mobile manipulation" OR all:"loco-manipulation") AND (all:deployment OR all:"real-world" OR all:recovery) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover real-system deployment and recovery evidence.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-cooperative-loco-manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:collaborative OR all:cooperative OR all:multi-robot) AND (all:"loco-manipulation" OR all:"mobile manipulation")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture coordinated payload manipulation and multi-agent variants.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-language-long-horizon-mobile-manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"mobile manipulation" AND (all:language OR all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:"long-horizon" OR all:planning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover semantic task planning and long-horizon mobile manipulation, while keeping it separate from motor-control evidence.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-loco-manipulation-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (loco-manipulation OR whole-body manipulation OR mobile manipulation) robot 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover named systems and spelling variants if the API under-recovers.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-loco-manipulation-calibration
dynamic_suggestions.query: recent robot loco-manipulation whole-body mobile manipulation 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate emerging method and benchmark names.

calibration_notes: arxiv-abs calibration (high): Exact recent use of multi-task loco-manipulation and whole-body control for an arm-equipped quadruped. Keyword calibration only.
arxiv-abs calibration (high): Recent use of collaborative loco-manipulation and long-horizon pick-and-place. Keyword calibration only.
arxiv-abs calibration (high): Recent use of tactile-aware quadrupedal loco-manipulation. Keyword calibration only.
arxiv-abs calibration (high): Recent use of human-like whole-body manipulation and whole-body visuomotor policies. Keyword calibration only.
arxiv-abs calibration (high): Recent use of scalable whole-body humanoid manipulation and wearable-exoskeleton data collection. Keyword calibration only.
